answer: Proof of fisherman catch licence via harbour board is a catch book of the kind the harbour master keeps: a licence the harbour board renews only after weighing a catch the fisherman actually landed. The garden is the net: cast, and the fish come up or it comes up empty. One invented catch takes a pen and a steady hand. Seventy invented catches take seventy boats, seventy tides the fisherman never sailed, and the whisper of each is the rope, coiled but never wet, the ember the quay where the unsold fish never lay.
